audience.text: Developers building .NET applications that require 3D scene construction, manipulation, and format conversion without native dependencies.

capabilities.text: Build and traverse 3D scene graphs using Scene and Node, with primitives and IFC-style profiles as entities.
capabilities.title: Scene graph construction

capabilities.text: Assign shading materials (Lambert, Phong, PBR variants) to nodes and convert between material types.
capabilities.title: Material assignment and conversion

capabilities.text: Read and write FBX, glTF, OBJ, STL, COLLADA, 3MF, PLY, and other formats using Scene.Open() and Scene.Save().
capabilities.title: Format conversion

capabilities.text: Configure import/export behavior using dedicated options types like ObjLoadOptions and ColladaSaveOptions.
capabilities.title: Per-format load/save options

capabilities.text: Define per-vertex data such as normals, UVs, colors, and tangents using VertexDeclaration and VertexElement.
capabilities.title: Mesh and vertex data control

capabilities.text: Animate scenes using AnimationClip, AnimationChannel, KeyFrame, Bone, Skeleton, and SkinDeformer.
capabilities.title: Animation support

limitations.text: Rendering APIs (Scene.Render, IRenderTarget, IRenderWindow) throw NotImplementedException in this FOSS build.
PLY import/export works via Scene.Open/Save, but direct use of the public FileFormat.PLY field throws NotImplementedException.
PolygonModifier and TriMesh helpers for triangulation, normal/UV generation, and boolean operations throw NotImplementedException.
3MF build-instruction metadata (IsBuildable, GetTransformForBuild) and RVM attributes are not implemented.
License and Metered APIs are present for API compatibility but are not functional in this open-source edition.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic creation and conversion of 3D scenes using pure managed code, avoiding reliance on external 3D engines or native libraries.
Supports interchange between common 3D formats such as FBX, glTF, OBJ, STL, COLLADA, and 3MF through a unified API surface.
Provides primitives and profile geometry for constructing complex 3D models directly in code without external modeling tools.
Allows material assignment and conversion (e.g., Lambert to PBR) for realistic rendering preparation in downstream tools.

product_summary.text: Aspose.3D FOSS for .NET is a free, open-source .NET library for building, traversing, and converting 3D scenes without external dependencies.

uncertainties: The README mentions PDF and Draco format support as not implemented, but no public symbols for PdfFormat or DracoFormat appear in the fact dossier.
The README states that the converter tool is not published to NuGet, but no package identity for it is listed in the fact dossier.
The README mentions AGENTS.md and docs/foss-net-progress.md for implementation status, but these files are not present in the fact dossier.
The README references external documentation URLs, but no fact confirms their current validity or content alignment with this version.
The README mentions 'rendering pipeline' in the Enterprise Edition, but no public symbols for rendering components are listed in the fact dossier.
The README states that 'NURBS control-point/knot-vector data can be constructed', but no public symbols for NurbsCurve or NurbsSurface appear in the fact dossier.

The README mentions 'Mesh post-processing utilities beyond basic scene-graph construction are not currently functional', but no public symbols for PolygonModifier or TriMesh appear in the fact dossier.
The README mentions 'Text watermarking is not currently functional', but no public symbols for watermarking appear in the fact dossier.
